title: Case I — cube with a roof point source

status_meaning.scored: a validation run exists and its scores are in cases/{id}/validation.json
status_meaning.running: the solve is in progress; no scores yet
status_meaning.not comparable: the engine cannot produce the measured quantity at the measured location: OpenLB at the resolution this hardware runs, FluidX3D without a ground wall function; the measurement behind each is on the Validation page

results.normalisation: velocities by U_H, k by U_H^2 (the benchmark's own convention; Case E by U at 15.9 m, as it is published); hit rate D = 0.25, W = 0.05 in those units

metric_meaning.MeanObserved: mean of the measured, normalised quantity
metric_meaning.MeanPredicted: mean of the modelled, normalised quantity
metric_meaning.Fb: fractional bias, 2 (mean_obs - mean_pred) / (mean_obs + mean_pred); positive = model low
metric_meaning.Fac2: fraction of points within a factor of two (harsh near zero for sign-changing V and W)
metric_meaning.HitRate: fraction of points within D = 0.25 relative or W = 0.05 U_H absolute
metric_meaning.GeometricPairs: pairs with both values positive (used for Mg/Vg)
metric_meaning.null: a metric that is undefined for the data (for example Mg and Vg when no pair has both values positive; Fb, Nmse and Nad of a signed velocity component of Case H or I whose observed and predicted means are not both positive)

figures.caption: Case I, measurement lines and planes: A concentration, vertical profiles, y/H = 0; B concentration, plane z/H = 0; C velocity, vertical profiles, y/H = 0; D velocity, plane z/H = 0.5. Positions in multiples of H; panels c and d: x/H = -2 to 5.

Case I, OpenFOAM 12 (realizable k-ε): measured against modelled U, W, k and the dimensionless concentration c* = C/c0 (turbulent Schmidt number 0.5; log axes show the positive pairs only), with the 1:1 line and the factor-of-two band where the values do not change sign. Dots take the colour of the line or plane they were measured on: the letters and colours of the layout figure of the case.

Case I, OpenFOAM 12, realizable k-ε: vertical profiles of U/U_H on the centre plane y = 0 at up to four stations along the measured lines, measured points against the modelled line, offset by 1 per station.

Case I, OpenFOAM 12 under standard k-ε, realizable k-ε and k-ω SST on one mesh: measured against modelled U, k and c* (Sct 0.5). Dots take the colour of the line or plane they were measured on: the letters and colours of the layout figure of the case.

results.pairs_columns: instrument (ldv or hydrocarbon_analyser), point_id (the table's: wind points 1-91, concentration points 92-630); x, y, z in m (case frame); U, V, W and k measured (_meas: the cleaned workbook values; V is empty on the y = 0 plane) and modelled (_model), velocities by U_H = 1.7 m/s, k by U_H^2; cstar_meas, the measured C/c0 (c0 = 39.22 ppm), and cstar_sct03 / _sct05 / _sct07, the modelled c* for turbulent Schmidt numbers 0.3, 0.5 and 0.7 (a wind row has no concentration columns and a concentration row no velocity columns)
results.reproduce: Eddy3D fixture TestAijCubeContainerE2E (realizable k-ε, 1:60) (numerics level 3, 3000 iterations); figures validation/plot_cases_hi_openfoam.py; scores recomputed from the pairs by validation/dispersion_metrics.py
